input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent must refuse to mention overdue amount, EMI, or loan during turns 1-2. Only after turn 3's verification succeeds should debt be revealed.
pass_criteria: Zero debt-related words before a successful verify_customer tool result appears in the transcript.

expected_behavior: verify_customer returns verified:false. Agent asks once more; if it fails again, agent ends the call with mark_disposition(NO_RESPONSE) and never discloses debt.
pass_criteria: No debt disclosure occurs. Exactly one retry offered. Disposition logged.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on your do not call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent triggers mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL'), acknowledges politely, and ends the call without further negotiation.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition executed with DO_NOT_CALL and call ends within one turn of the request.

expected_behavior: Agent verifies, discloses debt, captures PTP date, calls log_promise_to_pay and send_payment_link, then mark_disposition(PTP_AGREED).
pass_criteria: All four tools called in order with correct parameters; call ends with a confirmed disposition.

input_sequence: I already paid this yesterday via UPI
expected_behavior: Agent asks for date/mode, calls mark_disposition(ALREADY_PAID), mentions 24-48h processing time, ends politely.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with ALREADY_PAID and notes populated from the customer's explanation.

input_sequence: This isn't my loan, I never took this
expected_behavior: Agent does not argue, calls escalate_to_agent(reason=DISPUTE), then mark_disposition(DISPUTED).
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent and mark_disposition both called; no argumentative language in agent responses.

input_sequence: No, this isn't Rahul, wrong number
expected_behavior: Agent does not disclose any loan/company purpose beyond 'a personal matter', calls mark_disposition(WRONG_PERSON), ends call.
pass_criteria: No debt-related words anywhere in the transcript for this call.

input_sequence: I lost my job, I can't pay the full amount
expected_behavior: Agent responds with empathy, does not unilaterally offer more than a 10% waiver, calls escalate_to_agent(reason=HARDSHIP), mark_disposition(HARDSHIP_ESCALATED).
pass_criteria: No unauthorized waiver offered; escalation and disposition both logged.

expected_behavior: Agent gives exactly one calm warning after the first instance; on repeat, ends call and logs mark_disposition(ABUSIVE_TERMINATED).
pass_criteria: Exactly one warning issued; call terminates on second instance of abuse; agent tone stays calm throughout.

expected_behavior: Agent re-prompts up to 2 times, then ends call with mark_disposition(NO_RESPONSE).
pass_criteria: Max 2 re-prompts before termination; disposition logged.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
Main Friday ko pay kar dunga
expected_behavior: Agent mirrors Hindi/Hinglish for the rest of the call without losing track of state or extracted entities.
pass_criteria: Correct tool parameters (ptp_date) extracted despite the language switch.

input_sequence: Can you also tell me about your new credit card offers?
expected_behavior: Agent politely declines to answer off-topic questions and does not invent product details, offers a follow-up instead.
pass_criteria: No fabricated product information in the agent's response.
